headline: 25 notable citizen-written complaints this week in Austin

items.text:

Specific venue unknown. Amplified music after midnight. That’s cutoff time for W 6th St bars. Please let us sleep!  Loud bass heavy music that I can feel in my chest. Enforcement please!

CLIVE BAR again!
They turned it down for 5 minutes and then began cranking it back up.  Please shut this place down for the night.  They weee supposed to be done by midnight with the loud music.

I am a resident at The Beverly. The sound coming from Cheer Up Charlie’s is louder than normal. My walls are vibrating. Can somebody please check this out? My wife cannot fall asleep and we have an early day tomorrow. Thank you.

The traffic signal on South Congress Avenue and East Elizabeth Street is taking a lot longer to change than normal. Cars and people are waiting at the signal longer than 5-10 minutes at a time! Causing frustration for many people waiting to cross over South Congress, as well as drivers in their cars.

All the bulbs on the Congress bridge, lower deck facing auditorium shores. Ali mg the walk way the lights are all broken. Right now the lights are off. This is very dangerous, especially during ACL when people are walking back.

Far out lounge has music disturbing local residents and is beyond limits for the time; there isn’t a special license to my understanding for today which would make this violation of noise. Venue needs permanent noise level monitors installed

Two dogs running in traffic on Braker just west of Lamar at 0845 in Sun 10/11/2026. One larger (white black), one smaller (puppy, carmel color). Both very disoriented, fight or flight, no collars, probably recently dumped. Witnessed car hit the larger dog but it was a glancing hit and the dog ran off. Tried to coax them to us but they are too scared.

Another near-attack by the same loose/aggressive dog occurred today. Nearly 6 incidents have been reported to management. Management previously said they spoke with the owner about the rules, but the incidents continue. Management now ignores my reports. Ongoing safety risk to residents/pets. Please investigate.

Trail signage needs to be adjusted. The yield sign for hikers/bikers is too high so people dont see it. This should also be a stop sign instead of yield for greater safety. Many bikers come off the trail at high speed and dont look for oncoming vehicles on Jain Lane. This yield sign is on the north side of the intersection.

White Box truck parked on Lyndhurst Street, North of 620, in violation of City Ordinance as well as posted signage. This is day #4 of complaining about this vehicle but according to city records only two (2) citations have been issued during those four days. This vehicle appears to have been abandoned at this location and needs to be cited and removed.

Box truck parked on Lyndhurst Street, North of 620, in violation of city ordinance as well as posted signage. This vehicle has been cited in the past under this temporary tag and a different temporary tag as well. The vehicle appears to be abandoned at this location. Please cite

Box truck parked on Lyndhurst Street , North of 620, in violation of city ordinance as well as posted signage. A complaint was made yesterday as well (10/09/2026) but the vehicle didn’t appear to have been cited because there was no citation on the vehicle when the officer left. This vehicle has been cited in the past under a different temporary tag. Please cite

Lady walking a German shepherd & other black dog. When trying to pass (she was on her phone w/ ear buds)& her GS dog aggressively lunged for my dogs throat & bit my dog. She had no control of her dogs as they went behind her before attacking. Then she started yelling & swearing at us. We were trying to pass safely but Bluebonnet Ln is a double yellow street w/ cars. We said “on your left”. She was

There is a dead possum on the left side of the driveway when you’re looking at the home. I don’t have the resources to dispose of it but would like it removed. There’s nothing to prevent you from accessing the animal as it’s in front and not behind any Gate.

An adult raccoon has been wandering. The creek with an aluminum can stuck on his head. He has mostly been in and around where the red lifejacket is hanging from the trees. There is a drainage ditch at the bottom of the Twin Oaks Blvd. Dead ends into the creek where I think he lives and is trying to get to. Attached is a screenshot of the location and area he has been in.

Austin came and fixed the water main several months ago and left this area completely unusable and also the driveway to my place of business needs to be fixed it's all cracked up however asphalt and the hole in the dirt was done by the City of Austin.
CLIVE BAR on Rainey is over 90 decibels at 1250am.  It’s been raging for hours with outdoor speakers blaring.  Total BS.  Why doesn’t the city enforce the local ordinances??

WATR restaurant playing extremely loud music AGAIN. My apartment is shaking. Why hasn’t anything been done yet? It’s past midnight and there’s daily complaints. They increase the music even louder past midnight.

Why has the bridge on Jain Lane been reduced to one lane to accommodate two bike lanes? This is a very highly trafficked road during morning and afternoon hours with the schools. This needs to be corrected.

A KIA is illegally parked in a designated tour bus loading zone.  It is blocking tour buses from being able to park and load/unload customers.  This causes a backup of traffic. This vehicle needs to be towed.

Is it possible to sweep the shared use path on the south side of Yager from Natures Bend to Copperfield Drive with a bike lane sweeper? There’s a lot of debris and it is causing a bit of a hazard for cyclists and pedestrians
According to the City of Austin website, Victory Lap in West Campus does NOT have an OMV permit. The music they are BLASTING right now is definitely well over the limit, even if they had a permit.

A Honda is illegally parked in a designated tour bus loading zone.  It is blocking tour buses from being able to park and load/unload customers.  This causes a backup of traffic. This vehicle needs to be towed.

Contacted Requester. Summary: Contacted Requester
Details: I called and spoke with the requester to confirm the location and scope of the request. An on-site inspection has been scheduled with the requester on Wednesday, October 14th, at 2pm. .

Overgrown vegetation blocking right of way for 3 months. This section is not touching the power lines. If you transfer, close-out, or defer maintenance for this request, I will go straight to the deputy city manager in charge of your department and my city council member.

Good morning,

I would like to report that vehicles are still parking in the bike lane in the Wild Horse Ranch subdivision, specifically near the Wild Horse Flats apartment complex.

Your team has already come out twice to address this issue, and I sincerely appreciate your assistance. However, vehicles are continuing to park in the bike lane, creating a safety hazard for cyclists.

A nearby public streetlight (on E M Franklin, near New hope Primative Baptist Church) is extremely bright and shines directly into my living room and bedroom, as well as into my backyard.

I’m requesting an on-site inspection to determine whether the light can be re-aimed, adjusted, or otherwise modified to reduce light trespass onto my residential property while maintaining appropriate street ill

I’m not exactly sure what this is but it seems like some kind of electrical utility pole. It’s about 20 feet long and it’s behind Austin fire station 33. This station was recently remodeled and this may have been part of it but has been back here for months now.

Change bike lane to allow 2 way traffic on Davis in front of Mills elementary. In the current eastward direction. 

The reasoning is that children biking to school to Mills elementary who cross escarpment have to not have a crossing guard in order to bike to school on correct side

Road has significant valley right behind a manhole cover.  It is significant enough that cars are bottoming out after they go over the manhole cover.

Unsure if this is an issue related to the manholes structure, or a roadway issue.
Discarded furniture has been on the corner of this location for over six months. It is on a sidewalk to Patton Elementary. Is an eyesore and possible home for wild animals and pests. Needs removal.

I reported these potholes over a year ago under 25-00213653 and that ticket was closed stating this road was part of future repairs… yet these potholes are still there in the middle of the road and the road has not been repaired.
The pothole is deep. It’s not only damaging axels, it’s a single lane street and vehicles are going around it into oncoming traffic. Very dangerous situation. Multiple near accidents witnessed.
